title: Conditional finite-sector weighted-tail Cauchy bound
purpose: Provide an exact finite tail estimate that can be combined with the R-503 finite-block mixture bound once a source-owned full-Q law supplies nonnegative tail weights and a common cylinder-value envelope. This packet does not supply those weights, a tail rate, or a Gibbs limit.

fixed_scope.functional_and_states: Use unchanged PAH-001 fixed-Q functional and finite Gibbs components, the PAH-OMC-010 state-weighted norm with C_sw=540, and the PAH-OMC-014 full-Q cylinder question. No counterterm, rate refit, conditional averaging, new carrier, projection change, beta change or phase selection is introduced.
fixed_scope.finite_tail: For one finite tail index set s inside a source-owned full-Q component block, define T_s(w,a)=sum_{i in s} w_i a_i. The theorem is independent of the choice of enumeration and uses ordinary real absolute value.
fixed_scope.hypotheses: Weights satisfy w_i>=0, the common component envelope satisfies |a_i|<=c on s with c>=0, and the supplied tail mass satisfies sum_{i in s} w_i<=tau. The latter is a future source-owned input, not a value asserted by this packet.
fixed_scope.conclusion: The exact finite weighted tail obeys |T_s(w,a)|<=c*tau. If every tail component is exactly zero, the tail is exactly zero.
fixed_scope.combination_role: A future full-Q Cauchy proof may add this tail term to the R-503 finite-block error. R-503, R-504 and R-505 remain conditional support only; none supplies the present tail mass or the common envelope.

lean.scope: Abstract finite set and real-valued weights/components; no PAH sector law, Gibbs value, refinement, volume or limit is instantiated.

assumptions: The tail index set s is finite.
A nonnegative common envelope c bounds every absolute component value on s.
A source-owned tail-mass input satisfies sum_{i in s} w_i<=tau.
theorem_contract.conclusion: The weighted tail absolute value is at most c*tau.
not_supplied: No normalized full-Q sector law or projective kernel.
No source-owned values for tau, c, or the tail index sets.
No PAH-specific Cauchy rate, topology, uniform-integrability estimate or ordered limit.
No stationarity, positivity/normalization of a global state, or R-488 global nonzero conclusion.

boundary_and_uniformity.R-484: The hidden-diagonal boundary defect 16/9 remains retained in every future component input; this theorem neither removes nor averages it.
boundary_and_uniformity.R-490: C_sw=540 is a domination-only input and is not a probability, a tail mass, or a proof of this theorem.
boundary_and_uniformity.limit_order: The PAH-001 declared order is unchanged. A future source owner must establish tail mass decay in that order; finite tail control alone is not an ordered-limit proof.

non_claims: This is a finite conditional inequality, not a source-owned full-Q Gibbs law.
It does not prove a Cauchy sequence, a weak cylinder limit, projective consistency, positivity/normalization, stationarity, closability or a semigroup.
It does not repair the R-484 boundary defect or convert C_sw=540 into a measure.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, event horizon, gravity, QFT, Yang--Mills, mass-gap, cosmic-origin or TOE conclusion follows.
Markov time remains external stochastic time.
